info.description: This is the API documentation for the Connector service, which handles any kind of external integrations for Dengankarya.
info.title: Connector API Docs

get.description: Returns the merchant's combined balance: shipping wallet (available/on-hold) and payment settlement balance (settled/pending/paid-out).

Returns transaction-derived settled/pending/paid-out balance. Settled = SUM(merchant_amount) where status='settled'; PendingSettlement = status='paid'; PaidOut = completed payouts. AvailableToPayout = Settled - PaidOut.

post.description: Credits the merchant's available shipping balance. Restricted to admin API keys (ADMIN_API_KEYS). Called by the platform operator after the merchant has manually transferred funds.

get.description: Returns all shipment holds for the tenant, newest first.

post.description: Reserves shipping funds for a draft order. Deducts from available balance and adds to on_hold. Returns 422 when available balance is insufficient, 409 when an active hold already exists for the order.

409.description: Active hold already exists for this order

post.description: Transitions a hold from holding → confirmed. Removes the amount from on_hold (funds are considered disbursed to the shipping provider). Returns 409 if the hold is already confirmed or released.
Transitions a hold from holding → released and returns the amount to available balance. Use when an order is cancelled before shipment. Returns 409 if the hold is already confirmed or released.

200.description: Hold released, funds returned to available

post.description: Creates a pending payout withdrawal record for the merchant. The platform operator processes the actual disbursement manually via DurianPay. The amount is debited from availableToPayout once processed.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated unified activity feed for the tenant, sorted newest first. Supports filtering by type and date range.
Returns the full detail for a single activity item. For payment type items, metadata and ledger entries are also included. The `type` query param is required to identify the source table.
Returns normalized Indonesian address suggestions from a free-text query.

post.description: Validates email + password and returns a signed JWT (24-hour expiry).
Credits the shipping wallet of the specified merchant. Requires admin JWT + merchants:WRITE permission.

get.description: Returns all payout records across all tenants, newest first.
Returns cross-tenant transactions of any type, newest first. Filter by tenant_id, type, date range, and offset pagination.

parameters.description: Filter by type (payment, shipping_topup, payout, shipping_hold, shipping_adjustment)
parameters.name: type

get.description: Geocode an address using the provided address query

post.description: Creates a payment session via the configured provider and returns the checkout URL or VA/QRIS details.

Schedules a one-shot job that calls Tokokarya's cancel-expired-orders endpoint at the given Unix timestamp. Used by the frontend after a manual payment is created to trigger automatic order cancellation if payment is not confirmed.
Records a manual (off-platform) payment. Returns a provider_invoice_id prefixed with "manual-". Confirm via POST /payments/manual/:id/confirm.
Marks a manual payment as paid, writes ledger entries, and returns the updated transaction. Idempotent — safe to call again if already confirmed.

400.description: Invalid transaction ID or not a manual payment

get.description: Retrieves a payment transaction by its UUID for the authenticated tenant.

post.description: Fetches the live payment status from DurianPay for the given transaction and returns both the connector DB status and the live DurianPay status. Use this as a fallback when a webhook delivery is delayed — the caller can act on dp_status="paid" even before the connector processes the webhook.

get.description: Returns a list of districts for the given regency.
Returns a list of all Indonesian provinces.
Returns a list of regencies/cities for the given province.
Returns a list of villages for the given district.
Returns a cursor-paginated list of shipments for the tenant. Supports filtering by status.

parameters.description: Number of results per page (default 20, max 100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Pagination cursor returned by previous response
parameters.name: cursor

post.description: Creates a new draft shipment order via Biteship.

get.description: Returns a list of available shipping couriers from Biteship. Filter by comma-separated courier codes using the `only` query parameter.

parameters.description: Comma-separated courier codes to filter (e.g. jne,sicepat)
parameters.name: only

post.description: Returns available courier rates for a shipment before creating a draft order. Supply at least one location pair: area IDs (high accuracy), coordinates (required for instant couriers), or postal codes (easiest). Mix-and-match is supported (e.g. postal code origin + coordinate destination).

get.description: Retrieves a single shipment by its UUID for the authenticated tenant.

post.description: Promotes a draft shipment to a live order at Biteship. The shipment must belong to the authenticated tenant and have a valid provider draft order ID. Returns 402 if the merchant's shipping balance is insufficient.

400.description: Invalid request (e.g. missing tenant ID, invalid UUID)

post.description: Receives Biteship shipment status update callbacks. Authenticated via a configurable header key/value pair set in the Biteship dashboard.

checkout_url.description: payment page URL returned to the caller

discount.description: discount applied at order time; stored for reporting only

payment_data.description:
PaymentData holds provider-specific payment instructions returned at charge time.
For DurianPay VA: {"va_number": "...", "payment_instruction": {...}}.
For DurianPay QRIS: {"qr_string": "...", "qr_code": "..."}.
For DurianPay EWALLET: {"checkout_url": "..."}.

provider_payment_id.description: provider payment ID; populated on payment capture

shipping_fee.description: shipping credit topped up to merchant's balance

version.description: optimistic lock version; increment on every write

xendit_fee.description: Fee breakdown — populated after payment gateway confirms settlement.

order_number.description: OrderNumber is the tokokarya's order number.

tenant_id.description: TenantID is the merchant/tenant that owns this shipment.

address_line.description: AddressLine is the complete delivery or pickup address.

collection_method.description:
CollectionMethod defines how the shipment will be handed over.

Example values:
  - pickup
  - drop_off

email.description: Email is the optional contact email address.

latitude.description: Latitude is the optional coordinate latitude.

longitude.description: Longitude is the optional coordinate longitude.

name.description: Name is the contact person's name.

note.description: Note contains additional delivery or pickup instructions.

phone.description: Phone is the contact phone number.

postal_code.description: PostalCode is the postal or ZIP code.

amount.description:
Amount is the cash-on-delivery amount
in the smallest currency unit.

disbursement_type.description:
DisbursementType defines the COD settlement window.

Example values:
  - 3_days
  - 5_days
  - 7_days

price.description: Price is the final amount after any discounts/surcharges and optional fees.

shipping_fee.description: ShippingFee is the base shipping cost before any adjustments.

company.description:
Company is the courier provider code.

Example values:
  - jne
  - sicepat
  - anteraja

type.description:
Type is the courier service type.

Example values:
  - reg
  - yes
  - instant

courier.description: Courier contains the selected courier service.

destination.description: Destination contains receiver or delivery address information.

items.description: Items contains the list of shipment items.

metadata.description:
Metadata contains arbitrary internal metadata.

This field may be forwarded to providers that support metadata storage.

origin.description: Origin contains pickup or sender address information.

reference_id.description:
ReferenceID is the internal order or shipment identifier.

Providers may use this value as an idempotency key or external reference.

shipper.description: Shipper contains optional shipper or merchant information.

tags.description: Tags contains optional provider-level tagging information.

date.description:
Date is the optional scheduled delivery date and time.

This field is primarily used for scheduled deliveries.

insurance_amount.description:
InsuranceAmount is the declared insurance value
in the smallest currency unit.

type.description:
Type is the shipment delivery type.

Example values:
  - now
  - scheduled

use_insurance.description: UseInsurance determines whether shipment insurance is enabled.

courier_insurance.description: CourierInsurance is the declared item value for insurance (optional).

couriers.description: Couriers is a comma-separated list of courier codes (required).

destination_cash_on_delivery.description: DestinationCashOnDelivery activates COD; cannot exceed IDR 15,000,000 (optional).

destination_cash_on_delivery_type.description: DestinationCODType is the COD disbursement window: "3_days", "5_days", or "7_days".

items.description: Items is the list of items to ship (required).

origin_area_id.description: Area ID — highest accuracy; cannot be used with instant couriers.

origin_latitude.description: Coordinates — required for instant couriers (Gojek, Grab, etc.).

origin_postal_code.description: Postal codes — medium accuracy, easiest to implement.

note.description:
Note contains additional instructions
for proof-of-delivery handling.

category.description:
Category represents the shipment item category.

Example values:
  - fashion
  - electronic
  - groceries
  - frozen_food
  - others

description.description: Description is the optional item description.

height.description: Height is the item height in centimeters.

length.description: Length is the item length in centimeters.

quantity.description: Quantity is the total item quantity.

sku.description: SKU is the optional stock keeping unit identifier.

value.description:
Value is the declared item value
in the smallest currency unit.

weight.description: Weight is the item weight in grams.

width.description: Width is the item width in centimeters.

email.description: Email is the optional shipper email address.

name.description: Name is the shipper contact name.

organization.description: Organization is the optional organization or company name.

phone.description: Phone is the shipper contact phone number.

x-enum-comments.ActivityShipmentHold: funds reserved for a draft order

x-enum-descriptions: funds reserved for a draft order

available_to_payout.description:
AvailableToPayout is Settled minus PaidOut — the amount the platform
can still disburse to the merchant.

paid_out.description:
PaidOut is the total amount already disbursed to the merchant via
completed payouts from the platform account.

pending_settlement.description:
PendingSettlement is merchant_amount across 'paid' transactions not yet
marked settled (typically T+1 or T+2 depending on the gateway).

settled.description: Settled is the total merchant_amount across all 'settled' transactions.

gateway.description:
Gateway is the real-time balance from the payment gateway sub-account.
Nil when no gateway sub-account is configured for this tenant.

payment.description: Payment settlement — computed from payment_transactions and payment_payouts.

shipping.description: Shipping wallet — available funds and funds on hold for pending shipments.

AdminApiKeyAuth.description: Admin API key (ADMIN_API_KEYS) — required for operator-only endpoints such as balance topup
AdminApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-KEY
